title: Review of c34's Marangoni nematic rods (SIBWMD) on fresh seed 31: Supported, with my own passive twin (zeta=0, mar=0: 0 splits, 0 motion), mar=0 (0 swim-then-divide tracks) and two wall-off arms on the same seed
summary: Labkit re-run of c34's world.py on unused seed 31 (T=1000): rods form from uniform noise and divide by fission (26 persistent splits, generation 4); 7 tracks swim >= 3 labkit body lengths and then divide (best 5.7, track 16); the self-made surfactant ring passes on 100% of body-frames by signed distance and holds the cargo (in/out 10.1, all body-frames >= 2, all daughters >= 2x). Same seed controls: mar=0 gives 0 swim-then-divide tracks (best 2.39) with division intact; kappa=0 leaves the bodies identical and drops the cargo to 1.33; chis=0 (adsorption off, the protocol's wall-off) removes the ring and the cargo falls to 0.24; the passive twin (zeta=0, mar=0) makes 7 static ringed droplets with 0 splits and 0 tracks moving one body length. Caveat: by rod length no track reaches 3.

observations.S: rerun/sheet.png t=0: uniform noise over the whole box; rods nucleate at t~85-135
observations.B: sd_individuals.py ch2 on rerun: 532 body-frames, 100% pass rim/core and rim/out >= 1.5 (medians 2.59, 11.2); strip_ring_seed31_track16.png
observations.W: sd_individuals.py ch3: cargo in/out 10.1, 100% of body-frames >= 2; inherit.py: 36/36 daughters >= 2x five frames after birth
observations.M: swimdivide.py: 7 tracks swim >= 3 labkit body lengths then divide; track 16 net 41 px = 5.7 BL
observations.D: rerun FACTS: 26 persistent splits, generation 4; track 16 -> 42, 43

controls_run.W: ctl_chis0/ (adsorption off, the wall-off: ring gone, cargo in/out 0.24, 0% daughters >= 2x); ctl_kappa0/ (same bodies, cargo 1.33)
controls_run.M: ctl_mar0/ (seed 31: 0 swim-then-divide tracks, best 2.39 BL, max speed 0.119 vs 0.315)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. M passes on labkit's sqrt(area) body length; by rod length the best track is 2.84 and none reaches 3, as on two of c34's three seeds. In the chis=0 wall-off the diffuse surfactant fills the body and expels the cargo, and the Marangoni drive changes the bodies, so it shows the ring is what holds the cargo in, not a matched-body comparison; the kappa=0 arm is the matched-body one. The passive twin removes both non-diffusive stresses (zeta and mar); it loses M and D, while B and W (ring and cargo) persist in it, so only M and D are beyond diffusion.
